account.title: Account
account.subtitle: Protected sample page — you only see this when signed in.

notifications.title: Notification settings
notifications.subtitle: Choose how you hear about things. Changes save automatically — there's no save button.
notifications.saveError: We couldn't save that change. Check your connection and try the toggle again.
notifications.loadErrorBody: Something went wrong on our end. Give it another go.
notifications.alwaysOnDesc: These keep your account safe, so they can't be turned off.

browse.noResults: No matches for your search and filters.

home.needsYouMany: You've got {{count}} things waiting on you.

home.notOnTeamBody: Discover teams near you — many lend gear and welcome newcomers. No pressure; come try a training first.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Welcome back to JuggerHub.
signIn.verifyNotice: Please verify your email address before signing in.
signIn.resent: If that account needs it, a new verification email is on its way.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Join JuggerHub with your email and a password.
register.checkEmailBody: If that email can be registered, we've sent a link to verify your address. Open it to activate your account, then sign in.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for that address, we've sent a link to reset your password. The link expires shortly, so use it soon.

reset.doneBody: Your password has been updated and other sessions were signed out. You can now sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidBody: This reset link is missing information. Request a new one to continue.
reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a strong password you don't use elsewhere.

verify.verifyingBody: One moment while we confirm your address.
verify.successBody: Your account is active. You can now sign in.
verify.failedBody: This verification link is invalid or has expired. Enter your email to get a new one.
verify.resent: If that account needs verifying, a new link is on its way.

welcome.title: Welcome to Jugger
welcome.subtitle: Let's set up your player profile — takes about a minute.

name.title: What should we call you?
name.subtitle: Your display name — change it anytime.

city.title: Where are you based?
city.subtitle: Pick your home city — it powers teams and events near you.

team.title: Find your team
team.introNear: Teams closest to you first — the ones looking for new players are marked "Beginners". Or search by name for any team.
team.introFar: These teams are looking for new players — or search by name to find any other team.
team.loadError: We couldn't load teams just now.
team.noResults: No teams match that — try a different name.
team.emptyLooking: No teams are looking for new players right now — search by name to find any team.
team.askedConfirmation: We've asked {{name}} to let you in — an admin still has to say yes.
